component.name: MicSource
component.summary: Use your Android phone as a PC microphone

description.p: MicSource turns your Android phone's microphone into a real input device on your Linux computer. The phone records audio and streams it over an adb-forwarded socket, where it appears as a system microphone usable by any application.
Supports USB and Wi-Fi (Wireless debugging, Android 11+). Exposes the phone mic as a virtual input device ("phone-mic") and optionally plays audio through the PC speakers.
Initial Flatpak release of the Linux host suite.
